/product/ai-fluency-assessments/.title: AI Skills Assessment for Developers | SetBenchmark
/product/ai-fluency-assessments/.description: Assess how candidates plan, prompt, review and test with AI coding assistants and agents. Rubric-scored AI fluency tests for modern engineering roles.

mainEntity.name: What is an AI fluency assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI fluency assessment measures how well a person works with AI tools: breaking down a problem, writing clear prompts, reviewing AI output critically, testing it and correcting mistakes. It complements traditional coding tests.

mainEntity.name: Doesn't allowing AI make the test too easy?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Tasks are designed so that accepting AI suggestions blindly leads to wrong answers. Scores reflect judgement and verification, not just the final output.

mainEntity.name: Which AI assistant do candidates use?

acceptedAnswer.text: A built-in assistant and coding agent inside SetBenchmark, so every candidate has the same tools and everything is recorded. Personal AI tools stay blocked unless you allow them.

mainEntity.name: Who scores AI fluency tasks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your reviewers, using a published rubric. SetBenchmark summarises the session and suggests where to look, but people make the final assessment.

/product/ai-interviews/.title: AI Interviewer for Technical Screening | SetBenchmark
/product/ai-interviews/.description: Run consistent first-round technical interviews with an AI interviewer that adapts its follow-ups. Your team reviews every answer; nothing is auto-rejected.

mainEntity.name: Is an AI interview fair to candidates?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every candidate gets the same structure and rubric, which reduces interviewer-to-interviewer variation. SetBenchmark also offers text mode, captions and adjustments, and a person reviews every interview before any decision.

mainEntity.name: Does the AI decide who passes?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The AI suggests where answers meet the rubric and highlights evidence. A person on your team makes every decision.

mainEntity.name: How long is an AI interview?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually 20 to 30 minutes for a first round. You set the topics and time limit per role.

mainEntity.name: What languages does the AI interviewer support?

acceptedAnswer.text: English at launch, with captions and text mode. Ask us about other languages for your region.

mainEntity.name: What is a coding assessment platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: A coding assessment platform lets employers send candidates online programming tests, scores the answers automatically and helps the hiring team compare candidates. SetBenchmark adds real-world task types, AI-use policies and integrity review on top of automatic scoring.

mainEntity.name: Which programming languages does SetBenchmark support?

acceptedAnswer.text: More than 40 languages and frameworks, including Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, C#, C++, Kotlin, PHP, Ruby, SQL, React, Angular, Node.js and Spring Boot.

mainEntity.name: How long should a coding test be?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most roles, 60 to 90 minutes works well: one or two practical coding tasks plus a few short questions. Longer tests lower completion rates, especially for experienced developers.

mainEntity.name: Can candidates use AI tools like ChatGPT or Copilot?

acceptedAnswer.text: You decide per task. Mark a task 'AI not allowed' to test fundamentals, or 'AI allowed' to see how a candidate works with an assistant, the way they would on the job.

mainEntity.name: Can I use my own questions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Write coding, repository, SQL or multiple-choice questions in the question editor, or import them. Your questions stay private to your organisation.

mainEntity.name: How does SetBenchmark detect cheating in coding tests?

acceptedAnswer.text: It combines identity checks, optional camera and screen proctoring, code similarity analysis, paste and typing signals, tab switches and leak monitoring. Signals are sent to a person for review with the evidence attached.

mainEntity.name: Can SetBenchmark detect ChatGPT or other AI tools?

acceptedAnswer.text: It flags patterns typical of AI-assisted answers, such as large pastes and sudden bursts of complete code after switching away. For high-stakes tests, the secure desktop app (coming in 2027) can block other apps entirely.

mainEntity.name: Will candidates be rejected automatically?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. SetBenchmark does not reject, fail or lower a score on its own because of a signal. A person reviews and records an outcome with a reason.

mainEntity.name: Is proctoring compliant with India's DPDP Act and GDPR?

acceptedAnswer.text: Candidates see exactly what is recorded and agree before starting. Recordings are deleted automatically under your retention policy, and candidates can request their data.

mainEntity.name: Can candidates find SetBenchmark questions online?

acceptedAnswer.text: We monitor for leaked questions and rotate them out. Questions with variants change between candidates, which makes sharing answers much less useful.

mainEntity.name: Can we keep our own questions private?
